name: Running
notes: Treadmill or outdoor run tracked by distance and elapsed time.

guide.setup: Start at an easy pace with an upright posture, relaxed shoulders, and feet landing under the body.
guide.execution: Maintain the planned pace using short, light steps and a relaxed arm swing, then slow gradually to finish.
guide.cues: Run tall. Relax the hands. Keep effort sustainable for the session goal.
guide.mistakes: Starting too fast; overstriding; clenching the shoulders; ignoring pain that changes the stride.
